title: 无主句的表达
goal: 能根据语义选择不增添具体执行者的英文句型。

points.label: 判断无主句表达的语义类型
选择不增加原意的英文句型

sources.title: 大学英语六级考试大纲

body.p: 中文无主句常表达三种意思：某处有某物，人们通常怎么做，对某件事的评价。英文分别用 there be、泛指的主语、形式主语 it。原文没有说是谁做的，译文就不补出具体的人。

body.box:
原文：公园入口附近有一座小型木桥。
译文：There is a small wooden bridge near the park entrance.

cards.title: 存在句
rows: 村庄附近有一条通向山顶的小路。
There is a path near the village leading to the summit.
单数名词前用 there is。
这座老房子里有许多保存完好的家具。
There are many well-preserved pieces of furniture in the old house.
复数名词前用 there are。
小路旁曾经有一座石头建成的水井。
There was a stone well beside the path.
过去存在用 there was。
墙边曾经有两棵高大的栗树。
There were two tall chestnut trees beside the wall.
过去复数用 there were。

cards.title: 泛指主体
rows: 在这个地区通常用竹子制作轻便的篮子。
People in this region usually make light baskets from bamboo.
people 泛指当地的人。
在秋季经常把新收的果实储存在地窖里。
People often store the new harvest in cellars in autumn.
people 泛指一般的人。
在这里可以步行到达附近的自然保护区。
Visitors can walk to the nearby nature reserve from here.
visitors 指来这里的人。
在博物馆内必须保持展厅的安静。
Visitors must keep quiet in the museum galleries.
visitors 指要遵守这条规定的人。

cards.title: 形式主语
rows: 定期清理排水沟对于防止积水很重要。
It is important to clean drains regularly to prevent standing water.
it 代替后面的不定式。
保存原始记录对于核对研究结果很有必要。
It is necessary to preserve original records for checking research results.
it 代替 to preserve original records。
在大雨期间穿过这条河道是危险的。
It is dangerous to cross the channel during heavy rain.
dangerous 评价穿越行为。
按日期整理这些文件是比较方便的。
It is convenient to arrange these documents by date.
convenient 评价整理方式。

items.stem: 原文：这座花园的中央有一口古老的水井。选择译句。
options: There is an old well in the center of the garden.
People dig an old well in the center of the garden.
There was an old well in the center of the garden.
In the center of the garden has an old well.
items.why: 原文说花园中央现在有一口井，用 there is 引出单数的 well。第四项照搬了中文的「有」，句子没有主语。

items.stem: 原文：在当地通常用石头建造这种矮墙。选择译句。
options: There are low stone walls of this kind in this area.
People in this area usually build this kind of low wall from stone.
It is necessary to build this kind of low wall from stone in this area.
A local mason usually builds this kind of low wall from stone.
items.why: 「通常用石头建造」说的是当地的普遍做法，用泛指的 people 作主语。第四项补出了原文没有的具体执行者。

items.stem: 原文：检查船上的救生设备是十分必要的。排列译句。
chunks: the safety equipment on the boat
items.why: It is necessary to check 用形式主语引出对检查行为的评价。

items.stem: 原文：河边曾经有几座木头建造的小屋。排列译句。
items.why: 复数 houses 与过去式 there were 对应。

items.stem: 原文：提前预约博物馆导览是比较方便的。选择译句。
options: There is a museum tour booked in advance.
People always book the museum tour in advance.
It is convenient to book the museum tour in advance.
A museum guide finds it convenient to book the museum tour in advance.
items.why: 「比较方便」是对提前预约这件事的评价，用 it is convenient to 引出被评价的行为。第二项把评价改成了人们的固定做法。

items.stem: 原文：在这个地区通常用手工制作纸张。排列译句。
items.why: people 是泛指主体，usually make paper by hand 表示普遍做法。

items.stem: 原文：在图书馆的东侧有一个安静的阅览室。选择译句。
options: People use a quiet reading room on the east side of the library.
It is quiet to read in a room on the east side of the library.
On the east side of the library has a quiet reading room.
There is a quiet reading room on the east side of the library.
items.why: 原文说图书馆东侧有一个阅览室，用 there is 引出单数的 reading room。第三项照搬了中文的「有」，句子没有主语。

items.stem: 原文：在这个港口经常用小船运送新鲜的鱼。选择译句。
options: At this port, people often transport fresh fish in small boats.
There are often small fishing boats at this port.
It is useful to transport fresh fish in small boats at this port.
A fisherman at this port often transports fresh fish in a small boat.
items.why: 「经常用小船运送」说的是这个港口的普遍做法，用泛指的 people 作主语。第四项补出了原文没有的具体执行者。

items.stem: 原文：在开始实验之前检查仪器是很重要的。选择译句。
options: There are important instruments to check before the experiment.
It is important to check the instruments before starting the experiment.
Researchers always check the instruments before starting the experiment.
The laboratory director checks the instruments before starting the experiment.
items.why: 「很重要」是对检查仪器这件事的评价，用形式主语 it 引出不定式 to check。第三项把评价改成了研究人员的固定做法。

items.stem: 原文：村庄附近有几处适合露营的草地。选择译句。
options: People camp in several meadows near the village.
It is suitable to camp in several meadows near the village.
There are several meadows suitable for camping near the village.
Village residents keep several meadows near the village for camping.
items.why: 原文说村庄附近有几处草地，用 there are 引出复数的 meadows，suitable for camping 说明用途。第二项的 it is suitable to 不是英文的说法。

items.stem: 原文：山坡上有一座种植果树的小型农场。排列译句。
items.why: there is 引出单数 farm，后面补充果树和地点。

items.stem: 原文：在当地通常用干燥的竹叶包裹食物。排列译句。
items.why: people 泛指当地执行这一习惯的人，usually 表示通常。

items.stem: 原文：为旧照片注明日期对于保存家庭历史很有用。排列译句。
chunks: old photographs for preserving family history
items.why: It is useful to date 评价注明日期这一行为。

items.stem: 原文：在冬天检查房屋的供暖系统是必要的。排列译句。
chunks: the house's heating system in winter
items.why: it 是形式主语，to inspect 引出被评价的行为。
